title: Chamaerops humilis cerifera  Nov 30 2011
description: This silver leafed form of the Mediterranean Fan Palm really gives great foliage contrast in the fall garden, and contrasts beautifully with the deep greens of the surrounding more tropical looking foliage. The silvery succulent foliage of the Graptoveria 'Fred Ives' are a color echo to the palm foliage.  The glossy green foliage of Piper sanctum or Hoja Santa lies behind at the back fence.

title: Brugmansia, Strelitzia juncea and Aeonium Swartzkop  Nov 30 2011 (1)
Asparagus 'Meyers' and Arundo formosana 'Oriental Gold'  Nov 30 2011 (11)
description: The contrast in this photo doesn't really do the Arundo formosana justice; it simply glows in the late fall sun in this garden with the brilliantly white/yellow variegated foliage and fluffy form.

title: Delostoma roseum and Arundo formosana 'Oriental Gold'  Nov 30 2011 (10)
Brugmansia Charles Grimaldi  Nov 30 2011 (8)
description: The evening fragrance from the Brugmansia is a bit more understated this time of year, but the 100's of flowers open at one time still make it heavenly to walk out onto this terrace as night is falling.

title: Brugmansia Charles Grimaldi in bloom  Nov 30 2011 (5)
description: I had to do a major thinning of this while in full bloom, to lessen any wind damage from winter storms that are bound to arrive.  I don't think I had ever seen this so loaded with blooms, there must be at least 500 all blooming at once, if not a thousand.

title: Coleus foliage Nov 30 2011 (7)
description: The brilliance of these leaves isn't long for this world, as they can't last much longer without frost damage as the temperatures drop.  They still looked fresh at the end of November in this shot.

title: Ornamental Kale  Nov 30 2011 (3)
description: I love plunking these around the garden as annual color for the winter holiday season.  Along with cyclamen and violas, they take whatever a Bay Area winter throws at them and keep color all the way through the winter.

title: Nemesia fruticans in winter bloom Nov 30 2011 (6)
description: One of my "go to" herbaceous short lived perennial plants for nearly year round color in containers with winter sun.  This pale pink cultivar seems more strongly perennial than the 'Blue Bird' cultivar.

title: Justicia brandegeana in bloom  Nov 30 2011 (4)
description: This is one of those plants from Mexico that just never quits blooming here in the SF Bay Area if it likes the spot it is in.  Winter sun and shelter from strong winds is sufficient to keep it looking as colorful in December as in June...
